inputs: Exact source-spelled declarations are preserved in upstream_symbols and declaration_ids.
defaults: NMDC=false for ADC command parse/constructor; `getParam(index)` returns empty when out-of-range.
effects: AdcCommand stores 3-byte command integer, type, from/to SIDs, ordered parameter strings and feature string. Constructors make regular commands, addressed commands, status commands (status parameter is 000 for success/SUCCESS else severity*100+error), or parse a line. Command FourCC constants encode three chars by shifts; toFourCC/toSID reinterpret source bytes, so bridge should preserve source byte representation.

parse defaults NMDC false. It accepts `yxxx` style ADC or `$ADCxxx` NMDC form, validates length/type, assigns hub SID to INFO commands, and parses sender/recipient/feature fields for B/D/E/F types. Required sender, recipient and feature fields are checked; feature parameter bytes are validated and skipped rather than copied into `features`. Invalid lengths/missing fields, unknown escapes, trailing backslash throw ParseException. Recognized escapes are \s, \n, \\ and legacy NMDC \space. Feature field length must be divisible by five.

toString emits command header plus escaped ordered params with newline for ADC or pipe for NMDC. Header includes from/to/features according to type; CID overload is for UDP and serializes CID base32. escape replaces space/newline/backslash with ADC escapes or prefixes backslash in legacy mode. addParam(name,value) concatenates name+value as one parameter; map addition appends all map entries in its multimap iteration order.

getParam(index) returns emptyString when out of range. Named getParam searches from start for two-byte parameter code, returns the first value substring after two-byte code; list overload appends all matching values and returns whether output list is nonempty. hasFlag requires matching two-byte code and exact 3-byte parameter ending in `1`. addFeature appends + or - then feature text.

CommandHandler parses input inside catch(ParseException), logs invalid line and returns. Parsed callback runs only for non-NMDC. Typed dispatch invokes handler for listed known command IDs; unknown commands have no handler call and return silently.
errors: AdcCommand parsing throws ParseException for malformed lines; CommandHandler catches only ParseException and returns after logging.
behavior.completion: Synchronous parsing, formatting, lookup and event dispatch.

inputs: Exact source-spelled declarations are preserved in upstream_symbols and declaration_ids.
effects: SendCommandMessage fires DebugCommand(message,type,direction,IP) synchronously. Protocol events include incoming/outgoing hub (AdcCommand, Client reference), UDP (command, remote IP), TCP (command, remote IP plus HintedUser for incoming or UserConnection for outgoing). Outgoing UDP additionally carries OnlineUserPtr.

Source emitters: AdcHub fires outgoing hub and incoming hub commands at its send/receive paths; ClientManager fires outgoing UDP; UDPServer fires incoming UDP; UserConnection fires incoming/outgoing TCP. Speaker callback dispatch is synchronous on emitting thread; callbacks must not retain borrowed Client/UserConnection references beyond their owner lifetime.
events: DebugCommand, incoming/outgoing Hub/UDP/TCP command events with signatures described in effects.
